audience: sales teams who manage contacts, leads and opportunities in Insightly CRM

useCases.title: List open opportunities and their total value
useCases.text: The AI lists opportunities filtered by a field such as OPPORTUNITY_STATE, and adds up their values. It can map stage ids to stage names using pipelines.

useCases.title: Find leads updated since a date
useCases.text: The AI lists leads changed since a date or matching one field, such as LEAD_RATING, and shows their statuses and sources.

useCases.title: Review a record's notes, tasks and events
useCases.text: The AI opens a contact, organisation, lead or opportunity and lists the notes, tasks or events attached to it, so you get its activity history.

useCases.title: Find records by tag
useCases.text: The AI lists contacts, organisations, leads, opportunities or projects that carry a given tag.

useCases.title: Add a lead or a contact
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead or a contact from the details you give. For a lead it first looks up the valid status and source ids.

useCases.title: Create a task or note, or update a deal
useCases.text: The AI creates a task, adds a note to a record, or updates an opportunity's value, probability, dates or owner. Only the fields you pass are changed.
